research_contract.target: Establish the modern-panel incumbent by replaying the unchanged response-family Selectors that were previously evaluated on the legacy SWE-bench Full population.
research_contract.primary_outcome: Direct target-Agent future pass-rate MAE, with target Agents and Origins averaged inside repository and repositories weighted equally.
research_contract.observable_success: One unchanged candidate has lower direct MAE than Full at both H5 and H10 on the fixed-Harness primary lane and does not have higher MAE than Full at either horizon on the secondary complete-system lane.
non_solutions: changing algorithm constants, windows, priors, hazards, experts, tie breaks, horizons, or aggregation after reading a score
using Brier loss, response-vector loss, forecast loss, or random rank as the primary outcome
reading the target Agent's historical or future outcome column when constructing its Selection
using the secondary lane to choose or tune a candidate
opening the six project-sealed Verified full-system holdout Agents
claiming production, prospective, or independent confirmation
making a paid Agent call or developing a Generator

allowed: the other Agents' historical outcomes at or before the current Origin
the previous complete future block after it has entered current history
forbidden: the target Agent's complete outcome column
any current-Origin future Task or outcome
any other repository's Tasks or outcomes
information_contract.target_invariance: For every target Agent, perturbing its complete outcome column must leave that Agent's memberships unchanged.

frame.aggregation: target Agents and Origins inside repository, then repositories equally

candidates.mechanism: Choose the latest ten historical Tasks.
Choose ten Tasks whose other-Agent response vector matches the full historical other-Agent mean.
Combine full, recent, recent-two-block, and linear per-Agent response forecasts with coordinate-wise AdaNormalHedge, then exactly match the visible forecast.
Forecast the visible response vector with the frozen shared BOCPD change-point model, then exactly match it.

exclusions.reason: It was worse than Full at both legacy horizons and adds cross-repository state machinery. It is not needed to establish the strongest existing response-family incumbent.

report: share of 20000 random ten-Task draws as good as the candidate
evaluation.ranking: Report H5 and H10 separately. Do not construct a composite.
evaluation.retention_rule: Retain an existing mechanism only when it beats Full at both primary horizons and does not reverse on either secondary horizon.

reproduction.comparison: memberships and results must be byte-identical

claim_boundary: This is an outcome-open portability screen on public retrospective data. A surviving method becomes the modern development incumbent, not a validated production Selector.
